title: Mastery Rank/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Lotus transmissions during Mastery Rank tests.
- Lotus: "A Tenno must be a master of all their weapons. Prove yourself with you primary weapon."
- Lotus: "Prove your ability with a sidearm. Eliminate all targets."
- Lotus: "Show me that you know of the old ways. Eliminate all targets using your melee weapon."
- Lotus: "You have proven your skills with weapons, Tenno, but what of your endurance? Can you survive this onslaught?"
- Lotus: "Tenno are more than just fighters. Prove your intellect by hacking these terminals."
- Lotus: "Time to test your marksmanship. Track and shoot all targets."
- Lotus: "Your Warframe is a weapon. Prove you have mastered its power."
- Lotus: "Now we will test your agility. Shoot the targets to create your path."
- Lotus: "A full frontal attack is not always the best option. Using your stealth abilities eliminate all enemies without being detected."
- Lotus: "Careful Tenno, the ground beneath you is crumbling. Can you defeat these enemies before you have nowhere left to stand?"
- Lotus: "How well do you shoot under pressure? You must traverse this space before the timer runs out. Shooting the targets will buy you extra time."
- Lotus: "Your foes are not the only dangers you will face in the field. Avoid the lasers and defeat the enemies before the timer runs out."
- Lotus: "Your Warframe's movement abilities are key to this challenge. Defeat all the enemies before the ground completely falls away."
- Lotus: "This will be your hardest test yet. Defeat all incoming enemies"
- Lotus: "Show me you are capable of fighting on multiple fronts. Capture and hold more points than the enemy to succeed."
- Lotus: "Tenno, you can protect yourself, but can you protect others at the same time? Survive each wave while defending the objective."
- Lotus: "Let's see how you work under pressure. Eliminate all enemies before the timer reaches zero. Melee strike the orbs to have extra seconds added to the clock."
- Lotus: "Stay undetected while you melee strike all the orbs to free the prisoner. Once free, escort them to the safe zone."
- Lotus: "Tenno, show me you have mastered the Archwing, navigate this course before the timer expires."
- Lotus: "Passing through each ring awards additional time."
- Lotus: "You have proven your skills with weapons, Tenno, but what of your endurance? Can you survive this onslaught?"
- Lotus: "You're fast, Tenno, but are you nimble enough to capture each one of these mobile control points?"
- Lotus: "Your fragile Tenno body is one of the most powerful forces in the known Universe. Show me you know how to wield this force, destroy the target without being destroyed yourself."
- Lotus: "Show me your versatility, Tenno. Use both Archwing and ground fighting to reach the kill count goal. Melee strike the orbs to add extra seconds to the timer."
- Lotus: "You're fast, Tenno, but are you nimble enough to capture each one of these mobile control points?"
- Lotus: "Tenno, demonstrate superior battlefield efficiency. Kill and scavenge for beacons, and then quickly deliver them to the drop-off to earn the points needed to complete this test."
- Lotus: "Prioritize and eliminate. Throw these canisters at enemies and render them vulnerable. But hurry, Tenno, your time is limited and the canisters will expire."
- Lotus: "Tenno, you are but one against the horde. Your survival depends on speed. Go."
- Lotus: "Tenno. This is your true master test. Your only objective: survival."
- Lotus: "I believe you can handle more."
- Lotus: "You show promise. Alas, this is just the beginning."
- Lotus: "Our enemies are innumerable. There is no time for rest."
- Lotus: "Most disappointing. Only return when you are ready for this challenge."
- Lotus: "It appears you need more practice, Tenno. This challenge awaits you when you are ready."
- Lotus: "You have passed this test. Tenno, you give me hope that honor and balance may one day be returned to our system."
- Lotus: "A formidable performance. This test is now complete."
